dependencies.name: book-lookup
dependencies.description: Open Library (Internet Archive) — looks up book metadata (title, author, cover) by title or ISBN so a member can add a book without typing every field by hand. Free, no API key or signup required. No published OpenAPI document was found; the coding agent should research the live endpoints (search.json, /isbn/{isbn}.json, the covers API) directly against the base URL below.

config.description: Base URL of the Open Library API

description: Owns the shared book catalog and each member's personal read status and rating. Exposes REST endpoints to search the external book-lookup provider, add/remove books (via lookup match or manual entry), browse and filter the catalog, and upsert a member's own read/rating status. Aggregates per-book average rating and read count from member statuses. Does not render any UI and does not issue or validate tokens itself — the gateway validates the Thunder token and injects the caller's identity.
